prompt:
Hyper-realistic documentary photograph, shot on 35mm Fujicolor Superia 400 pushed one stop — fine natural grain, a green bias off the fluorescent light, muted and cool. Naturalistic motivated lighting only, no lens flares, calm observational tone.

Scene: the man from the reference images, on the same 2008 trading floor, is standing up on top of his desk among the monitors, both arms thrown up, a telephone handset still in one fist with its coiled cord pulled taut down to the desk, his mouth wide open mid-roar. Below him at the next desks two traders in shirtsleeves look up at him: a South Asian man in his forties half out of his chair, and a Black British man in his twenties grinning with a phone at his ear. Further back, a mixed room of men and women at their desks.

Camera: low, from the aisle at desk height, looking up at him, wide lens, the desk edge and a spilled stack of printouts in the near foreground.

Lighting: overhead fluorescent tubes; every monitor and wall board is only a soft out-of-focus glow of colour with nothing legible on it.

Details: real skin texture, sweat at the collar, fine natural grain, ordinary and unstyled. Keep every screen and paper free of readable lettering or numbers.

Compose for a 16:9 frame.

Thanks.
why: Kai r1: trading-floor mania instead of the lift; QA pass 2: readable screens and one-ethnicity room fixed
